hook_text: A shack can burn down in minutes. Which materials would you choose instead?
clip_script: Langa, after a winter fire. A Grade 5 class designs a new home. Floor: concrete, strong and durable. Walls: fired bricks, strong and they do not burn. Windows: glass, waterproof and lets in light. Bathroom: glazed tiles, waterproof, with a rough texture so wet feet do not slip. Walls painted bright yellow: colourful, and paint keeps out the rain. Every choice matches a property.
visual_style: Whiteboard house being built part by part, with a property badge stamped on each material.
mood: Hopeful and purposeful, like designing something that matters.
pacing: Problem first, then five fast material choices, each with its property badge.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and redesign one room in your home with the six properties.
